physics: Non-tilted axisymmetric Bianchi I, signature (-,+,+,+), a_perp=a e^{-b}, a_par=a e^{2b}, s=db/dt, Sigma=sqrt(3)|s|/H

derived_equation.shear: ds/dt + 3 H s = (8 pi G/(3 c^2)) DeltaP_tot
derived_equation.from: d/dt(V beta_dot_i) = (8 pi G/c^2) V pi^i_i, V=a^3, beta=(-b,-b,2b), pi^3_3=(2/3)DeltaP
derived_equation.sign: DeltaP>0 increases s; then d grows and A'(0)<0 lowers DeltaP: negative feedback
derived_equation.linear_sensitivity: delta s(x)=int^x exp(-3(x-x')) (8 pi G/(3 c^2 H(x'))) delta DeltaP(x') dx' at fixed background, first order

owner_match.omitted_feedback: k=8*pi*G/(3*c^2); delta_s=(1/a^3) int k a^3 DeltaP dt (trapezoid); perturbative diagnostic, background unchanged

required_owner_alignment: Owner normalization matched (axbi_background.rs omitted_feedback, rates); a coupled run must evolve b,s with DeltaP_tot instead of the owner perturbative diagnostic
Use the owner's DeltaP_tot including any existing stock and physical anisotropic source unchanged

inputs.new_source_rules: P2 or P24 positive frozen birth weights from the verified native adapter; rank-one only via rank1_certificate
inputs.source_history: owner source emissivity; cohort weights frozen at birth
inputs.angular: n_mu in {8,16,32}; S6 criterion predicts insufficiency for |b+d|>~0.6

gates.C1_constraint: owner Friedmann/Hamiltonian residual within the owner's existing gate, not relaxed
gates.C2_energy: dU/dx+4U+2 b'(x) DeltaP = source term, per cohort, relative 1e-11
gates.C3_angular_separation: same history with prior/P2/P24 and n_mu 8->16->32; report delta s and delta b trajectories
gates.C4_linear_prediction: compare measured delta s with linear_sensitivity using measured delta DeltaP; report ratio, no admission from agreement alone
gates.C5_spectral: cells_per_segment and n_energy refinement separated from angular change, as S6c

NCP: Required only if the owner history run exceeds the local limits; then only compile/small compatibility fix/run remain
